data.name: Facility 009
data.description:
TYPE: SUPREME THREAT // SUPREME ANOMALY // SUPREME MACHINE
DATA: Unlike Sol, 009 is a ATAS Class facility, well…it formerly was…009 has Male AI Programming, Unlike Sol who has Female Programming.

009 was to be banished to Lechery inside Purgatory…punished to suffer the cold howling wings of Lechery, however. There was a flaw with its punishment.

It used Lechery’s winds to generate enough power to stay alive and build metal & steel towers for illegal science experiments.

Sometime later, an Expedition from Hydros Robotics found 009 doing illegal experiments, Hydros Robotics ordered 009 to be immediately shut down and terminated, since some humans worked and built 009.

009 would immediately terminate communications with Hydros Robotics, and would still continue illegal experiments until it decided to make small troops to support it.

Appearance: Facility 009 has 3 enormous and large buildings conducting science and weaponization. It’s first building is a 231 meter-tower like structure with a bridge connected to a tower that is close to it, housing the factory that Facility 009 makes its tiny army of machines, it’s second tower Is a gigantic 374 meter tower with steam vents to eject heat, it has a interior and with a elevator too. Its third tower is the same as its second tower.

It’s main facility in the middle is the same as 3-ATAS, it’s main core is a grey shaped stationary facility with a head rotating in a 360 degree angle that can close or open the covers and a telescope in the head, the inside of the facility has a large hollow interior with computer monitors to monitor its facilities.

Inside of its core is a large dark grey humanoid machine with a height of 11’4 and a single left arm with four sharp black fingers, it’s head is Triangle-shaped with 1 optic on the left and right to see, and tiny six white eyes on the top of the triangular-shaped head, four thin black commutation antennas are on its back to communicate with its soldiers.

SOLDIERS

002-THTOS “FREEZER”
TYPE: SUPREME MACHINE 
HEIGHT: 4’9
DATA: Unlike 002-THTOS “HERMES”, 002-THTOS “FREEZER” is a Variant of Hermes.

Its primary functionality was scouting and combat. Utilizing its speed and twin blades, dubbed Blizzard and Whiteout respectively…

Sentry Appearance: Sentries are lime green machines with pink lights and light gray accents around their limbs, a pair of powerful legs with pistons in the back, and visible four-fingered "toes". They have a green, metallic box with ammunition placed at their rear. They have a large gun with a rectangular nozzle resembling a sniper rifle in the place of their head, a singular pink eye at their left, and a thin antenna with a small pink, blinking spoke.

Repair And Maintenance Series 700
TYPE: GREATER MACHINE
DATA: Originally built by the Japanese to support the 1000-THR “Earthmover’s”, but now they were reprogrammed to protect Facility 009 and repair it incase there is a severe critical damage

The Repair And Maintenance Series 700 Unit is a repair robot that can lift heavy objects, every of these units carry a Light Machine Gun to gun down enemies.

V2 “ICEBLADE”
TYPE: HALF-SUPREME MACHINE
MISC: MACHINE BUILT-V MODEL
OTHER MISC: SCIENTIST AND MASS PRODUCED COMBAT ROBOT
ICEBLADE HEIGHT: 4’7
DATA: Like the original V2 that is made by humanity, V2 “ICEBLADE” is a ice-blue V-Model with a built-in Knuckleblaster, replacing its left arm to make slow powerful punches while in combat.

They use a standeredlnized durable plating on its chest, since durability was important for Facility 009, the V2 “ICEBLADES” have extremely powerful heaters in their torso to not freeze inside Purgatory’s Layer. Lechery.

V2 Iceblade Appearance: V2 ICEBLADE is almost identical to V1 and the original V2 in terms of appearance, having a humanoid form with an elongated, cylindrical head resembling a camera with a bright yellow lens. It also has eight winglike protrusions, and the label "Iceblade" is embossed on its chestpiece to its left. In contrast to V1, its entire body is ice-blue and it is armed with the Knuckleblaster.

Weaponry V2 Iceblade can use: Piercer Revolver, Sawed-On Shotgun, Attractor Nailgun.

GUTTERMAN “ICE-BREAKER”
Appearance: Guttermen “Ice-Breakers” are large, bulky machines with a primarily dark ice-blue coloration, with a dark ice-blue paint job for their circular, dome-shaped helmets dotted with several black "eyespots" with the color of blood-red. They have darker brown bellies made of a flexible, leathery material, and have rather stumpy, cone-shaped legs. They are armed with a large, rectangular riot shield in their left hand, while their right hand is replaced with a large, cylindrical five-barreled chaingun. Their shield, helmet, and belly also have slight black accents.

Additionally, they wear a large coffin on their back which, after death, it can be broken open with heavy damage to reveal a medium-sized fan running at cold temperatures to power them, and a medium-sized lightbulb to generate heat.
